title: 10 Best Accounting Software for Vacation Rental Managers
summary: Compare 10 accounting tools for vacation rental managers, from Topkey and Guesty Accounting to QuickBooks and Sage Intacct, by the job each one does best.
body_markdown:
*Updated November 2026*


Month-end at a vacation rental company is really three jobs at once. You keep your company's own books. You track the owner and guest money you hold in trust. And you sort a constant stream of card charges, receipts, vendor bills and OTA payouts into both.


Most accounting software is built for one of those jobs, maybe two. So many teams end up with QuickBooks, a PMS, a few spreadsheets and one bookkeeper who knows how it all connects.


Below are 10 of the best accounting tools for vacation rental managers, grouped by the job each one does best. Topkey comes first, and the rest are in reading order, not a score.


## The 10 Tools at a Glance


Tool Type Best for


Topkey Vacation rental finance platform Automating the daily work and syncing it to your PMS and ledger


VRPlatform Short-term rental accounting software Moving your whole books to an STR-specific ledger


Guesty Accounting Accounting inside a PMS Guesty users


Track Accounting inside a PMS Larger Track users


Escapia Accounting inside a PMS Large managers who want one all-in-one system


Streamline Accounting inside a PMS Streamline users


Hospitable Owner accounting inside a PMS Growing Hospitable users


QuickBooks Online General ledger The company's own books


Xero General ledger Teams that like Xero's bank reconciliation


Sage Intacct General ledger 500+ units and multi-entity groups


## How We Picked and Checked These Tools


We included accounting tools that vacation rental managers actually use, across three groups: platforms built for vacation rental finance, accounting built into a PMS, and general ledgers. Each one had to handle at least one of the four jobs in the next section.


We checked every feature claim against the vendor's own website on November 24 and 25, 2026. We left out pricing because it changes often, so check current pricing with each vendor.


## What Vacation Rental Accounting Software Has to Handle


Generic small business accounting assumes the money in your bank account is yours. In vacation rentals, much of it belongs to owners and guests. That one difference changes how your books have to work.


Every dollar needs a property and an owner attached. Without that, building an owner statement means digging through bank feeds line by line. Owner and guest money also has to stay apart from company money. Many states require it, and owners expect it everywhere.


Payouts have to match reservations, too. One Airbnb deposit can cover a dozen stays, minus fees and adjustments, and someone has to tie it back to each one. And owners need statements and payouts they can trust. Late or wrong statements are one of the fastest ways to lose an owner.


No single type of software covers all four on its own. That's why the list is grouped.


## Built for Vacation Rental Finance


These two tools are built only for vacation rental money, but they take opposite approaches. Topkey works alongside the PMS and general ledger you already have. VRPlatform replaces your general ledger with its own.


### 1. Topkey


Topkey is the AI-powered financial operating system built specifically for vacation rental managers. It handles the vacation rental side of your accounting, from bookkeeping to trust accounting and owner statements, and syncs it into your PMS and ledger.


**How it handles your accounting.** Topkey does the vacation rental work around your ledger and syncs it to QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, Xero, Sage Intacct or Oracle NetSuite, so your CPA keeps the ledger they know.


[Topkey's AI accounting](https://topkey.io/ai-accounting) codes each transaction to your chart of accounts with a property tag. Anything it isn't sure about goes to a person, so your team reviews exceptions instead of every line.


[Trust accounting](https://topkey.io/trust-accounting) keeps a double-entry ledger of whose money is held and reconciles payouts daily.[Owner statements](https://topkey.io/owner-statements) are drafted from PMS reservations and owner expenses, with commission figured per stay from each contract, and every owner is approved, sent and paid from one list.


It also catches what slows a close: duplicate bills, mismatched payments, missing receipts and out-of-policy spend. Emailed bills and receipts get read and tagged to a property,[revenue reconciliation](https://topkey.io/revenue-reconciliation) splits Airbnb lump sums into reservations, and card charges, bills and inventory supplies post to the right owner with your markup.


**Where Topkey isn't the right fit.** It isn't a general ledger, so you'll still need QuickBooks, Xero or similar. And if you only manage properties you own, there are no owner statements or owner money to track, so a ledger alone may be enough.


**Best for:** managers who want bookkeeping, owner statements and payout matching handled without changing PMS or ledger, especially once receipts and owner charges start eating days at month-end. Larger groups on Sage Intacct or NetSuite use it to feed in clean, property-level data.


[Visit Topkey](https://topkey.io/)


### 2. VRPlatform (VRTrust)


VRPlatform's VRTrust is accounting software built by short-term rental accountants. It doesn't sit next to your general ledger. It is the general ledger, with trust and operating books in one system.


**What it does well.** VRTrust has a full double-entry ledger and three-way trust reconciliation between the bank ledger, bank statements and owner balances. Bank feeds auto-match, and batch payouts from OTAs and payment processors break out into reservations. It builds customizable owner statements with an owner portal, pays owners by ACH, connects to PMSs like Hostaway and Lodgify, and tracks revenue for co-hosting models.


**Where it falls short.** Moving your whole general ledger is a much bigger project than adding a tool. Your bookkeeper or CPA has to learn a new system, and years of history have to come over. VRTrust also focuses on the ledger and trust side, so company card spend and vendor bills need their own process upstream.


**Best for:** managers ready to leave QuickBooks or Xero for an STR-specific ledger.


[Visit VRPlatform](https://vrplatform.app/)


## Accounting Built Into Your PMS


Several property management systems include their own accounting. The upside is that reservations and accounting live in one place. The catch is that you only get it with that PMS, and most companies still run their own books in a separate ledger. Expense capture, such as company cards and receipts, is also rarely the focus, so that work usually happens somewhere else.


### 3. Guesty Accounting


Guesty Accounting is the accounting suite inside Guesty, a popular property management system for short-term rentals.


**What it does well.** It's built around trust accounting, with double-entry bookkeeping and automated journal entries. AI matches bank transactions automatically. You get customizable and annual owner statements, owner and vendor payouts by native ACH and NACHA files, and 1099 generation. Guesty says it complies with North Carolina and Queensland trust accounting regulations.


**Where it falls short.** It only works if Guesty is your PMS. If you ever switch PMS, your accounting has to move too.


**Best for:** Guesty users who want owner accounting in the same system as reservations.


[Visit Guesty Accounting](https://www.guesty.com/features/accounting/)


### 4. Track


Track is an enterprise vacation rental PMS, and its trust accounting is a big reason larger managers pick it.


**What it does well.** Track has offered ledger-based trust accounting for about two decades. It runs owner statements weekly or monthly and handles owner taxes, including the 30% the IRS requires you to withhold from foreign owners' earnings. It also includes more than 60 accounting and owner reports.


**Where it falls short.** Track describes its accounting as made by and for trust accountants. That depth is the point, but a team without an experienced trust accountant on staff has a lot to learn.


**Best for:** larger managers already on Track, with an accounting team to run it.


[Visit Track](https://trackhospitality.com/features/vacation-rental-trust-accounting-software/)


### 5. Escapia


Escapia is a vacation rental PMS backed by Expedia Group, with more than 25 years of trust accounting behind it.


**What it does well.** Escapia puts trust accounting, reservations, housekeeping, owner reporting and an owner portal in one system. It's built for large professional managers, and its trust accounting has a long track record.


**Where it falls short.** Because it's all-in-one, you take on Escapia's reservations, housekeeping and owner tools along with the accounting. That's a hard trade if your team likes the tools it already has.


**Best for:** large managers who want reservations and trust accounting under one roof.


[Visit Escapia](https://escapia.com/features/trust-accounting/)


### 6. Streamline


Streamline is an enterprise vacation rental PMS with an NC-accredited trust accounting suite.


**What it does well.** You can pay vendors in trust or out of trust, manage travel agent income and expenses, and run accounting reports from the same system as reservations. Streamline also has more than 100 preferred partners.


**Where it falls short.** Streamline's accounting is one part of an enterprise platform. It makes sense when you're ready to run your whole operation on Streamline, not as a quick fix for month-end.


**Best for:** managers who run Streamline as their PMS.


[Visit Streamline](https://www.streamlinevrs.com/features/trust-accounting/)


### 7. Hospitable


Hospitable is a vacation rental platform for hosts and property managers, from one property to 1,000.


**What it does well.** Monthly owner statements build themselves from live reservations, and owner payouts go straight to owners' bank accounts. Owners get a portal with your logo and colors. Hospitable calculates management commissions, connects to QuickBooks, and offers trust accounting with bank reconciliation and owner-level ledgers to eligible managers.


**Where it falls short.** Trust accounting is only for eligible managers, so check before you count on it. Your company books still live in QuickBooks or another ledger.


**Best for:** growing managers on Hospitable who want statements and payouts handled in their PMS.


[Visit Hospitable](https://hospitable.com/property-managers/)


## General Ledgers


Every vacation rental company needs a general ledger for its own books: payroll, rent, software, taxes and the company P&L. These are the three most common choices.


### 8. QuickBooks Online


QuickBooks Online is one of the most widely used small business accounting tools in the US, and most vacation rental bookkeepers already know it.


**What it does well.** It has bank feeds, classes and locations for tracking by property, a huge app marketplace and a big network of accountants. Almost every vacation rental tool integrates with it.


**Where it falls short.** QuickBooks doesn't know what a reservation, an owner or a trust balance is. So someone tags every transaction to a property class by hand, and works out each owner's balance in a spreadsheet. Each company also needs its own file, which gets messy with several entities.


**Best for:** the company's own books, paired with a vacation rental tool for the owner side.


[Visit QuickBooks Online](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/)


### 9. Xero


Xero is a cloud accounting platform known for fast bank reconciliation and unlimited users.


**What it does well.** Reconciling bank feeds in Xero is quick, and tracking categories let you report by property. It has a large app marketplace and works with most vacation rental software.


**Where it falls short.** It has the same blind spots as QuickBooks around reservations and trust. Xero also allows two active tracking categories. If you use one for property and one for owner, you have nothing left for market or entity.


**Best for:** teams that prefer Xero's reconciliation workflow for the company books.


[Visit Xero](https://www.xero.com/)


### 10. Sage Intacct


Sage Intacct is a cloud financial management system for growing and mid-size companies.


**What it does well.** Dimensions let you tag transactions by property, owner, entity and more, and it consolidates multiple entities. The reporting is strong, which is why larger groups move to it.


**Where it falls short.** It's usually set up with an implementation partner, so switching takes months, not days. And like any general ledger, it doesn't handle reservations or owner payouts on its own.


**Best for:** 500+ unit companies and multi-entity groups.


[Visit Sage Intacct](https://www.sage.com/en-us/sage-business-cloud/intacct/)


## The Bottom Line


Most vacation rental companies end up with a combination: a general ledger for the company books, trust accounting for owner money, and some way to get the daily work into both. If you run Guesty, Track, Escapia, Streamline or Hospitable, owner accounting may already be close by. The gap is usually the daily work in the middle.


Topkey is #1 on this list because it closes that gap. It handles the daily bookkeeping and the owner side, then syncs everything into the ledger you already use.


[See how Topkey works with your accounting](https://topkey.io/)


## Frequently Asked Questions


### What is the best accounting software for vacation rental managers?


Most vacation rental managers use two kinds of software together: a general ledger like QuickBooks Online, Xero or Sage Intacct for company books, and a vacation rental tool for owner money. Topkey is built for that setup. It automates bookkeeping, trust accounting and owner statements, and syncs with both your PMS and your ledger.


### Can I use QuickBooks for vacation rental property management?


Yes, for your company's own books. QuickBooks doesn't track reservations, owners or trust balances, so tagging properties and building owner statements becomes manual work. Most managers pair it with PMS accounting or a tool like Topkey.


### Do vacation rental managers need trust accounting software?


If you hold owner or guest money, you need to keep it separate from company money, and many states require it. Trust accounting software tracks whose money is whose and reconciles it against the bank, so you can prove every owner's balance.


### What's the difference between PMS accounting and a general ledger?


PMS accounting tracks reservations, owner balances and trust money. A general ledger tracks the company's own income, expenses and taxes. Most vacation rental companies need both, and the work is keeping them in agreement.


### Does Topkey replace QuickBooks?


No. Topkey works alongside QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, Xero, Sage Intacct and Oracle NetSuite. It handles the vacation rental work, like property tagging, trust accounting and owner statements, and syncs clean transactions to your ledger.


### How do I match OTA payouts to reservations?


Use software that breaks lump-sum payouts into the reservations they cover. Topkey connects to Airbnb directly and matches Vrbo, Booking.com and Marriott payouts from their reports. Guesty Accounting and VRPlatform also match payouts to reservations. Either way, your team stops matching each deposit by hand.
